{{Quote|Oh, you mean those goldskins? Aren't they the other swoop riders from this afternoon? But what are they doing here?|[[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla|Fiolla]] to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="hsr" />}}
The '''Nothoiins''' were golden-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]], native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]] in the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]]. They possessed innate [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] abilities; a skill especially drawn out in the [[Cogennan Nothoiin]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]]. Many Nothoiin were involved in criminal activities, both in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]], and in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].

==Biology and appearance==
Nothoiin skin was golden and flaky, and gave rise to the nickname "goldskins." As a [[Species/Legends|species]], most Nothoiins had an innate [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] ability, although the [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] known as the [[Cogennan Nothoiin]] especially developed this capacity, and were known for their piloting savvy.<ref name="gg" />

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|Although most Nothoiins now speak Basic, our first form of communication is ''sign language''.|[[Troov]]|<ref name="The Runaway Ride">{{TCWComicCite|6.50|The Runaway Ride}}</ref>}}
The Nothoiins used a sign language known as [[Notho]], developed by hunters on the plains of [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]]. When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] began colonizing the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] around [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the Nothoiins also adopted [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], although their native language remained predominant.<ref name="gg" />

==History==
[[File:Nothiin.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A star map of the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] showing the location of Nothoiin.]]
The Nothoiins traded with the Galactic Republic on and off for centuries ([[Ur-diamond/Legends|Ur-diamonds]] being the major export) and this encouraged greater exploration of the region, although this was hindered by the lack of accessible [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes. This changed when [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] blazed a star lane through the [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]]. Figg also ensured the Nothoiins profited from the opening up of trade with the Republic.<ref name="gg" />

Around a billion Nothoiins lived on their original [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], although the planet never became heavily developed, and was predominantly covered in rolling plains. However, after fifty consecutive years of drought since the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], raging fires had become the norm for the planet. [[Kilometer/Legends|Kilometer]]-wide burn rings surrounded the sparse [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] to prevent the fires from encroaching. A pall of ash became a virtually constant reality on the planet, and many Nothoiins moved to other colony worlds to escape the destruction.<ref name="gg" />

Nothoiins were commonly found throughout the region on worlds such as [[Bavva/Legends|Bavva]], [[Kirtarkin/Legends|Kirtarkin]], [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]], [[Ione/Legends|Ione]], and [[Polmanar/Legends|Polmanar]],<ref name="gg" /> and were one of the four dominant species in the region.<ref name="RT">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325adv|text=Rough and Tundra|int=Rough and Tundra}}</ref> They established a number of colonies in the Greater Javin, which sent representatives to the planet [[Council (planet)/Legends|Council]], a democratic governmental base for decisions affecting the various colonies. Nothoiins were also commonly found in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="gg" />

==Nothoiins in the galaxy==
Nothoiins often made use of their piloting abilities by becoming pilots and [[Navigator/Legends|navigators]]. However, a large number also became involved in criminal activities.<ref name="gg" /> A group of Nothoiin [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] riders tried to attack [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla|Fiolla]] on [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]] in retaliation for killing the [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Zlarb/Legends|Zlarb]]. When they evaded them on swoops, the Nothoiins then tried to catch him returning to the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. However, Solo saw them and left the planet on another ship.<ref name="hsr" /> The Nothoiin, [[Covah]], was also involved in criminal activities on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and had to flee the planet to avoid [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] capture. He hired the [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillian]] [[Solomahal/Legends|Solomahal]] to transport him offworld, and returned to the Greater Javin to hide.<ref name="gg" />

The Nothoiin [[Taray]] served as one of the few non-Human members of the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Wing Guard]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. He was more concerned with upholding the spirit of the law, and sometimes technically broke laws in order to do so. After Cloud City declined under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Hugo Treece|Treece]], Taray left to find other work in the Javin.<ref name="RT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The first appearance of the Nothoiins was in ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'' ([[1979]]); however, they were not named and only referred to as "goldskins". These swoopriders became the basis for the Nothoiin species that was named and described in ''[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]''.<ref name="gg" /> Twice in the supplement the name is misspelled as "Notion". [[Jason Fry]] has indicated that fellow ''Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin'' author [[Craig Robert Carey|Craig R. Carey]] intended for ''[[Crisis on Cloud City (adventure book)|Crisis on Cloud City]]'' criminal [[Helm Iskraker]] to be of the [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]] species.<ref name="Galactic Cartography">{{JCFCite|url=posts/28672620|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2008-07-01|time=1:12 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802094309/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-57}}</ref>
